note: Chinese public-holiday calendar for the daily schedule. `off` are the days the State Council designates as holidays; `work` are the weekend days it designates as make-up working days (调休). Data mirrored from NateScarlet/holiday-cn, which cites the State Council notice in `papers`; gov.cn itself is refused by this environment's network gateway, so these dates could not be read from the primary source here -- confirm them against the notice before relying on a full year. A year that is missing from this file is not an error: the run falls back to Monday-Friday and says so, because losing a day of intelligence is worse than one unnecessary run.
makeup_note: false means a 调休 Saturday does not run, matching "周一到周五，节假日不跑". Set true to also run on those days.
